notes.title: Demo release!
notes.notes:
The very first tech demo of Aetherfall is here!
This early build is mostly a showcase of our multiplayer combat system and dynamic interaction mechanics:

Projectiles colliding with projectiles can create elemental fields

Projectiles passing through fields are transformed

Dashing through a field triggers special effects such as buffs or powerful AOE damage.

Melee abilities can destroy or reflect with incoming projectiles

While it’s focused mainly on PvP, there are also a few monsters to battle for some PvE action.

It’s a very early stage glimpse into Aetherfall’s foundations — your feedback will help shape where we go next.
Jump in, experiment, and let us know what you think!
